activities.name: Get
activities.description: Resolve a token value from a path.

coverage.notes: MappedTokenAdapter reads original Plan.Path. Invoke-MappedTokenAdapter derives trimmed Path (or replaces it from Container/Resource), creates a new TokenPlan with only Path, and conditionally copies original Config. Concrete Path reads consume that derived value, not additional original properties. All Get pairs have shared mapped reads; no pair is zero-read or reserved-no-op. Concrete validates Get and reads constructed Path. Its local helper accepts Plan but reads no Plan properties; operation text comes from the derived Path parameter.

MappedTokenAdapter reads original Plan.Path. Invoke-MappedTokenAdapter derives trimmed Path (or replaces it from Container/Resource), creates a new TokenPlan with only Path, and conditionally copies original Config. Concrete Path reads consume that derived value, not additional original properties. All Get pairs have shared mapped reads; no pair is zero-read or reserved-no-op. Concrete validates Get and reads constructed Path. Helper Key fallback is unreachable on mapped success because constructed Path is nonempty; nested reference dispatch copies Config but creates its own Path. Other adapter internals are opaque.

MappedTokenAdapter reads original Plan.Path. Invoke-MappedTokenAdapter derives trimmed Path (or replaces it from Container/Resource), creates a new TokenPlan with only Path, and conditionally copies original Config. Concrete Path reads consume that derived value, not additional original properties. All Get pairs have shared mapped reads; no pair is zero-read or reserved-no-op. SDA does not validate Activity locally, but mapped dispatch fixes Get. It clones TokenPlan and appends jacket Config, overwriting matching top-level Config children. Descendant attribution below is conditional on preservation; Plan/Phase clone reads are not original fields because dispatch never forwards them. Dynamic handler names are selected from Path; ImageDimensions and EntityLevel handlers add no Plan property reads. The commented StoreItemIcondentity call is not executed.

properties.description: Resolve a dynamically selected descendant of the original forwarded configuration.

evidence.trace: Memory.plan scope assigns dictionary=constructed TokenPlan. path comes from the selected token suffix; default starts null and may become the string after | or =. Attribution is only to descendants of original forwarded Config; generated Path, other Plan fields and cache/generation/item/Signal scopes are excluded. Symbolic [$path] is a full TokenPlan-relative expression, not a fixed literal child.
evidence.condition: Memory.plan scope selects an original Config descendant and reaches the resolver; no claim of arbitrary original Plan forwarding.
